parse_gps_file: parse a KITTI GPS file to extract lat/lon coordinates and rotation matrix from yaw, pitch, roll
parse_split_file: parse a KITTI split file to extract sequence names and optional 3D shift vectors
parse_calibration_file: parse a KITTI calibration file into a dictionary of rotation, translation, and projection matrices
get_camera_calibration: get camera intrinsics and GPS-to-camera extrinsics from a KITTI calibration directory for a given camera index
review_split_files: review the KITTI split files list containing test1, test2, and train file names
